scope: Show Glass Tux in all Golden Gate README translations and pin the shared installer with light and dark Glass Tux emblems.

checks.command: Ran three focused wrapper tests for local-source staging and verified-pin selection.
Staged Golden Gate defaults against the release source and verified both installer emblems against the README assets.
Verified the published Tahoe tag and immutable archive, matching versions, both shared installer image assets and git diff --check.

coverage_limits: The Welcome page was rendered by the native Qt wizard with offscreen light and dark palettes. No installation transaction was run.
approval: The maintainer reviewed the Glass Tux previews and requested publication in every README and in the installer.
